title: Endpoint & Device Management
description: Standardise, patch, and govern the laptops and phones that staff actually use. Tests asset management, patch scheduling, and BYOD/MDM policy design.

seo.overviewBody: Managing laptop and mobile hardware fleets requires centralized endpoint management tools. IT teams evaluate candidates on Microsoft Intune or Jamf configuration, automated patch deployment, disk encryption (BitLocker/FileVault), and compliance policies.

deliverables.title: 1. Corporate MDM Security Policy Spec
deliverables.desc: Device management policy establishing passcode rules, OS patch baselines, and app installation restrictions.

deliverables.title: 2. Intune / Jamf Compliance Configuration
deliverables.desc: Configuration profile enforcing mandatory disk encryption, firewall activation, and remote wipe capabilities.

deliverables.title: 3. Endpoint Encryption Audit Report
deliverables.desc: Fleet compliance audit documenting BitLocker/FileVault recovery key escrow and unencrypted device remediations.

faqs.question: What is BitLocker recovery key escrow?
faqs.answer: Key escrow automatically backs up full-disk encryption keys to Entra ID (Azure AD) or Active Directory so IT can assist users with locked drives.

faqs.question: How does MDM protect corporate data on BYOD mobile devices?
faqs.answer: MDM isolates corporate apps and emails inside a secure container separate from personal user data, allowing remote wipes of business data without deleting personal photos.

faqs.question: Why automated OS patch management necessary?
faqs.answer: Unpatched operating system vulnerabilities are primary entry vectors for malware. MDM enforces mandatory patch windows.
